{{- $versions := partialCached "versions.html" . -}} {{- if gt (len $versions) 1 -}} {{- $cur := .Page.Section -}} {{- $active := (index $versions 0).version -}} {{- $label := "Version" -}} {{- /* The first entry whose dirpath is this section wins. In a dev or preview build the list is "local" (this build) followed by the live versions, and the newest live one has the same dirpath (gdc-ui: latest), so a later match would label this build with it. */ -}} {{- range $versions -}} {{- if eq $cur .dirpath -}}{{ $active = .version }}{{ $label = printf "Version (%s)" .version }}{{ break }}{{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{/* Every archived version still ships the pre-reorg flat structure, and the reorganized pages have no 1:1 path parity with it. A page can name its old location in `legacy_path` front matter (its `aliases` list the same old URLs); the menu then deep-links each version to that page. No legacy_path -> link to that version's homepage instead of guessing. */}} {{- $legacyPath := "" -}} {{- with .Page.Params.legacy_path -}}{{ $legacyPath = strings.Trim . "/" }}{{- end -}}
{{- /* The archive page lists every version with changelog and API links; it used to be a top-level tab, now it heads this menu. It is found by its `versions_archive: true` front matter, so it can live wherever the sidebar makes most sense (today: API Reference). */ -}} {{- with index (where site.Pages "Params.versions_archive" true) 0 -}} All versions {{- end -}} {{- range first 4 $versions -}} {{- $href := .url -}} {{- if $legacyPath -}}{{ $href = printf "%s/%s/" (strings.TrimSuffix "/" .url) $legacyPath }}{{- end -}} {{ .version }} {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
